name: Momentum Top-3 Europe Equity + 15% Vol Target
description: Selects the top 3 assets by 12-month trailing return from the European equity universe (broad Europe, EMU, France CAC 40, EURO STOXX 50, STOXX Europe 600), weights by inverse volatility, then scales to 15% annualised volatility. Rotates between overlapping regional equity flavours to capture within-Europe leadership.
